title: A new look at active vs passive (Michael Green)
summary: Michael Green of Thiel Macro presents a thesis that the growth of passive investing distorts how markets price new money flows. He ties short-term market behavior to longer-term demographic cycles and its effects on valuations and volatility.
why: HN points to it in investing threads as an argument that passive index flows distort markets and could precede a crash.

quote.text: You'd probably be interested in listening to this talk by Michael Green
